key_idea: The strict inequality is established by translating the problem into operator-theoretic bounds on the percolation connectivity matrix via Riesz-Thorin interpolation, which are then controlled by embedding the discrete graph into continuous hyperbolic space and analyzing half-spaces.
reason: The argument stunningly unifies operator theory, continuous hyperbolic geometry, and discrete probability, using deep structural theorems (Bonk-Schramm, Riesz-Thorin) to avoid intractable probabilistic calculations. While the conceptual framework is highly surprising and powerful, the heavy reliance on complex machinery and necessary geometric bookkeeping adds structural intricacy.
